_what: Script for the Jensen Huang allegations video (Nolan 11/13: funny, raunchy, all animated, Jensen drawn and named; one cut for TikTok and a YouTube Short, about 80 s). Facts only from research/106-jensen-huang-story-factpack.md. NOT yet checked by a second model. The builder draws each line's `vis`; the only on-screen words are `card` and `signs` (and the captions of `say`).
_rules: Jokes aim at Jensen Huang's own admitted conduct and at Meatball. No woman is named or joked about; nothing about his family. Unproven claims stay attributed. The line that names a country is clean. Captions soften swear spelling (cap_swap). Title, description and caption are clean.

lines.say: The Jensen Huang allegations, explained. Buckle up, it's a mess.
lines.vis: Frame 0: cartoon Jensen (black leather jacket, silver hair, glasses) on a keynote stage in a spotlight, holding a graphics card up like a trophy, already moving. Meatball hops in small at the side with a news mic.

lines.say: He ran Nvidia. Never took off that leather jacket. Everything else? Different fucking story.
lines.vis: Jensen struts across the stage; the jacket gets its own little sparkle. On 'Everything else' he freezes, sweat drop, tugs his collar.

lines.say: November eighth, he emailed the whole company: I was unfaithful to my wife. I am deeply sorry.
card: HIS EMAIL TO STAFF, NOV 8 (NVIDIA NEWSROOM)
lines.vis: Office. Jensen at a laptop presses a huge SEND key; an envelope flies out and multiplies across the screen.

lines.say: He built a chip empire and still couldn't manage his own hardware.
lines.vis: Jensen holds the graphics card; its fans spin up, it smokes and droops; he looks down at it, mortified.

lines.say: Meatball read the email to his cat, Sauce. Sauce left the damn room.
lines.vis: Meatball's living room. Meatball reads a phone aloud with the news mic; the orange cat, Sauce, turns and walks out of frame.

lines.say: It started October twenty-ninth: the New York Times reported U.S. officials believe a woman he was involved with was spying for China.
lines.vis: A newspaper front page slides in (blank lines for text, the card carries the words). Jensen reads it and the graphics card slips out of his hand. No woman is drawn.

lines.say: The same report said officials don't think he knew. Nobody's been charged. China calls it groundless speculation.
lines.vis: Three stamps land one after another on the newspaper: HE DIDN'T KNOW (REPORTED), NO CHARGES, DENIED. Jensen wipes his forehead.

lines.say: Monday, Nvidia lost about 190 billion dollars in market value, Reuters reported. Most expensive side quest in fucking history.
lines.vis: A giant stock chart; the line falls off a cliff and Jensen rides it down like a slide, jacket flapping. Meatball watches with popcorn.

lines.say: Then the Times and Reuters reported more affairs, not confirmed by him or Nvidia. If true, that's serious fucking multithreading.
lines.vis: More newspapers pile up on Jensen until only the jacket collar and glasses show. A little CPU with many glowing threads spins on 'multithreading'.

lines.say: A November twelfth filing: he resigned as president, CEO and board member, effective immediately.
lines.vis: Back on the stage: Jensen sets the graphics card on the podium, hangs his badge on the mic stand and walks off; the spotlight stays on the empty stage.

lines.say: He used to say: the more you buy, the more you save. Now it's: the more you stray, the more you pay.
card: "THE MORE YOU BUY, THE MORE YOU SAVE"
THE MORE YOU STRAY, THE MORE YOU PAY
lines.vis: A keynote slide with the first line; it flips over to the second with a cash-register ding. Jensen facepalms.

lines.say: Interim CEO: finance chief Colette Kress. First job, the most awkward all-hands meeting ever.
lines.vis: An office door with a fresh INTERIM CEO sign being hung. Nobody else real is drawn: an empty podium facing rows of empty chairs.

lines.say: Three House committee chairs reportedly asked for a closed-door briefing. Closed doors. That's how this shit started.
lines.vis: Huge double doors slam shut; Jensen stands outside them, sweating. On 'Closed doors' Meatball gives the camera a slow look.

lines.say: So which part broke your brain? Because
card: WHICH PART BROKE YOUR BRAIN? COMMENT
lines.vis: Back to the frame-0 stage and pose so the loop into j1 is seamless; the question sits in a top-corner pill.
